==Major events==
{{Spoilers}}
* {{an|Misty}} rejoins {{Ash}} in the [[Orange Islands]].
* {{Ash}} earns the [[Orange League]] championship [[Winner's Trophy|trophy]].
* Ash and {{Gary}} meet up at a Pokémon research convention.
* Ash and Gary begin traveling together.
* [[Jessie]] and [[James]] are revealed to be a [[RocketShipping|married couple]].

==Party changes==
===Additions===
* {{p|Snorlax}} ({{OP|Ash|Snorlax}}) in [[ET15]]
* {{p|Slowpoke}} ({{Ash}}'s) in [[ET19]]

===Trades===
* Ash trades his giant {{p|Slowpoke}} for a photo of [[Daisy Oak|May Oak]] in [[ET19]].

==Gym battles==
Ash battles the following Gym Leaders in this volume: 
* [[Rudy]] in [[ET16]] (win)
* {{OBP|Drake|Orange League}} in [[ET18]] (win)

==Monthly releases==
[[File:Surfs Up Pikachu issue 1.png|thumb|Issue #1]]
Just like the first three volumes, Electric Pikachu Boogaloo was released by [[VIZ Media]] as [[List of Electric Tale of Pikachu monthly issues|four monthly issues]] containing one to two chapters each, comprising the entire volume collectively, which was released separately. These monthly comic book issues were released around 2000. As a bonus, these monthly releases each contained fan letters and fan artwork which were not included in the regular volume releases. 

The following monthly comic book issues were released:
* [[Surf's Up, Pikachu issue 1|Issue 1]]
* [[Surf's Up, Pikachu issue 2|Issue 2]]
* [[Surf's Up, Pikachu issue 3|Issue 3]]
* [[Surf's Up, Pikachu issue 4|Issue 4]]
